notes.message: query messageReactions returns a page of 32 reactions rows with no cursor, so the page cannot continue
notes.rewrite: if the screen pages, declare `c: cursor ?` in messageReactions and append `after c` to this reactions page, keeping its current predicate, direction and column order

notes.message: query groupByTitle: this lookup does not pin an authorized row's id; matching a name does not prove uniqueness or absence. The server may return matches but cannot certify complete. The held replacement (check --verbose) keeps the same matches and shape on the device; it requires acquired coverage and has no server fallback. Keep the original query if server lookup is required
notes.rewrite:
query groupByTitle(title: text 1..50) held:
  return first(conversations where .kind = 'group' and .title = title first 1 by .id)

notes.message: query searchMessages: when the search text folds to no words, the page over messages[..] by read or declaration on likes (at, id) at schema.q:75:3 or read or declaration on messages (at, id) at schema.q:342:10 or read or declaration on posts (at, id) at schema.q:64:3 or read or declaration on reposts (at, id) at schema.q:86:3 is never `complete` — the read rule `exists members[.conversation, viewer]` reads .conversation, which the scan does not pin, so the server cannot tell "no more" from "more you may not read"
notes.rewrite: pin .conversation with where equalities as well as the current equality prefix, choosing the intended scope (this narrows the answer); or read the page on the device, where the partition holds exactly what the viewer may read

notes.message: posts: each contributing commit logs and streams the whole parent image per destination partition, coalesced once per row; a 4,000-byte parent costs every holder about 4 KB per change
notes.rewrite: use a column when readers want the count with the row; for a large row or a counter changing far more often than it is read, use a view with online only
